data.tax_note: Contributions to the statutory accident insurance (Berufsgenossenschaft) are deductible business expenses (Betriebsausgaben) for your painting business.
data.title: Berufsgenossenschaft: New hazard class assessment from 2027
data.summary: Musterbau-Berufsgenossenschaft informs Bastian Musterquell that his painting business will be assessed from 1 January 2027 under its new hazard tariff: hazard class 7.4 (Gefahrklasse) for the painting trade and unchanged 0.6 for office staff. The contribution itself will still be calculated after year-end from reported wages, and an objection (Widerspruch) can be filed within the deadline shown.
data.explanation: This letter from your statutory accident insurer (Berufsgenossenschaft) sets the risk categories (Gefahrklassen) used to calculate your 2027 contributions for your painting business; no payment is due yet, as the actual contribution is calculated after the year ends based on wages you report. If you disagree with the assigned hazard classes, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person; the app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final. Keep this letter for your business tax records, as these contributions are deductible expenses.
